import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  const container = new Group();
  const activeTimelines = [];

  // 1. PALETTE SETUP
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // 2. TEXTURED MAIN PLATE
  // Since this is "Journal card 3 label" rendered as a plane
  const plateGeo = new PlaneGeometry(1.6, 1.0);
  const plateMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: new Color(colors.surface),
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });

  const plateMesh = new Mesh(plateGeo, plateMat);
  container.add(plateMesh);

  // 3. BACKGROUND ACCENT EDGE (Providing the requested hover / focus highlight)
  const borderGeo = new PlaneGeometry(1.64, 1.04);
  const borderMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: new Color(colors.ink),
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.8
  });
  const borderMesh = new Mesh(borderGeo, borderMat);
  borderMesh.position.z = -0.01;
  container.add(borderMesh);

  // 4. IMAGE LOADING
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-mock/home/nodes/floating-accent.png';
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      plateMat.map = texture;
      plateMat.color.set('#ffffff'); // Reset to pure white to let texture show correctly
      plateMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch(() => {
      // Fallback color if load fails
      plateMat.color.set(colors.surface);
    });
  }

  // 5. TEXT CONTENT
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  let headlineText = "Journal 3";
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.role === 'headline' || item.text) {
      headlineText = item.text;
      break;
    }
  }

  // Generate crisp MSDF text via the custom font Atlas
  const textElement = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineText, {
    fontSize: 0.12,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  textElement.position.set(0, -0.05, 0.02);
  container.add(textElement);

  // 6. DECORATIVE SIGNAL BAR
  const signalGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.3, 0.015);
  const signalMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: new Color(colors.accent)
  });
  const signalMesh = new Mesh(signalGeo, signalMat);
  signalMesh.position.set(0, -0.28, 0.02);
  container.add(signalMesh);

  // 7. INVISIBLE INTERACTION LAYER
  const hitGeo = new PlaneGeometry(1.7, 1.1);
  const hitMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ visible: false });
  const hitMesh = new Mesh(hitGeo, hitMat);
  hitMesh.position.z = 0.05;
  container.add(hitMesh);

  // 8. INTERACTION & ANIMATION LOGIC
  container.userData = {
    handlers: {
      pointerover: () => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        // Lift effect + show red accent border
        tl.to(plateMesh.position, {
          y: 0.15,
          z: 0.05,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power3.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(textElement.position, {
          y: 0.1,
          z: 0.07,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power3.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(signalMesh.position, {
          y: -0.13,
          z: 0.07,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power3.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(borderMat.color, {
          r: new Color(colors.accent).r,
          g: new Color(colors.accent).g,
          b: new Color(colors.accent).b,
          duration: 0.3
        }, 0);
        activeTimelines.push(tl);
      },
      pointerout: () => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        tl.to(plateMesh.position, {
          y: 0,
          z: 0,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power2.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(textElement.position, {
          y: -0.05,
          z: 0.02,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power2.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(signalMesh.position, {
          y: -0.28,
          z: 0.02,
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'power2.out'
        }, 0);
        tl.to(borderMat.color, {
          r: new Color(colors.ink).r,
          g: new Color(colors.ink).g,
          b: new Color(colors.ink).b,
          duration: 0.3
        }, 0);
        activeTimelines.push(tl);
      },
      pointerdown: () => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        tl.to(container.scale, {
          x: 0.96,
          y: 0.96,
          z: 0.96,
          duration: 0.1,
          ease: 'power2.out'
        });
        activeTimelines.push(tl);
      },
      pointerup: () => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline();
        tl.to(container.scale, {
          x: 1.0,
          y: 1.0,
          z: 1.0,
          duration: 0.2,
          ease: 'back.out(2)'
        });
        activeTimelines.push(tl);

        // Emit navigation/selection event
        ctx.emit('hub-journal.select', { id: config.id ?? 'journal-3' });
      }
    },
    cleanup: () => {
      activeTimelines.forEach((t) => t.kill());
      plateGeo.dispose();
      plateMat.dispose();
      borderGeo.dispose();
      borderMat.dispose();
      signalGeo.dispose();
      signalMat.dispose();
      hitGeo.dispose();
      hitMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return container;
}
